target_customer: AI agent vendors who need to deploy agents inside customers' private systems, and the customer security and engineering teams who govern access
problem: Agents that work across company boundaries need trusted access to customers' private apps, databases and APIs. Trust and access, not intelligence, are the barrier to deployment.
business_model: B2B infrastructure software, vendors integrate once and customers govern each deployment
product_category: Zero-trust access layer and gateways for AI agents

founders.name: Aditya
founders.background_notes: YC page gives only a first name and cites the launch post: ML pricing models as a quant options trader at IMC. The site names the operator as AlphaDI Labs Inc.

competitors.what: Zero trust controls for how AI agents connect to networks and data

competitors.what: Open-source zero trust MCP and LLM gateways with outbound-initiated connections

competitors.name: Xage Security
competitors.what: Zero Trust for AI with Agent Sentry and Resource Gateway across SaaS, cloud and data center

competitors.name: Outerlimit
competitors.what: Zero-trust authorization for agent requests, agentic AI security

technical_complexity.rationale: Outbound-only gateways, policy, approvals and audit trails are standard secure networking engineering, with hard parts in security assurance and enterprise trust for a tiny team.

defensibility.rationale: Large security vendors and funded startups were shipping similar agent access controls in 2026. Integration by vendors could create some switching costs later.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents launched agent zero trust products in March to June 2026, before the Fall 2026 batch.

market_need_then: Zscaler, Cisco and others launched agent zero trust products in 2026 and trade coverage describes security and governance as leading agent funding, which indicates enterprise concern about agent access.

identity.visual_style: Clean and minimal with diagrams of agents, private networks and customer systems
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct, product-focused, short declarative headings

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand found. The name suggests routing and resembles an agent noun, but no source explains it.

outcome_analysis: Routant joined YC in Fall 2026 and has no public outcome yet. Its wedge is a vendor-integrated zero-trust access layer for agents, in a space where large security vendors launched competing products months earlier. The record rests on the YC page and company site only, so traction is unknown.
